summary: commonweb-flow pulls attacker-controlled tarball with install script from artifacts.yosiroute.com
details: commonweb-flow@5.8.999 declares a direct URL dependency `linker-event-header-serial` pointing at https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial, bypassing the npm registry. The shrinkwrap records `hasInstallScript: true` for that tarball, so running `npm install` on this package fetches and executes code from that host on the installer's machine. The URL is unpinned (no version, no integrity hash), making the served bytes attacker-mutable. Package metadata is placeholder boilerplate ('Generated package', author 'Package Registry', example.com repo URL) and the declared version 5.8.999 conflicts with the 1.0.0 self-reported in index.js, consistent with a dependency-confusion shell whose sole purpose is to pull the install-scripted external tarball.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
